title: Typing Zoo
tags: typing,keyboarding,touch typing,keyboard,home row,typing practice,typing lessons,computer skills,fingers,pets,elementary,grade 1,grade 2,grade 3,grade 4,grade 5
description: Learn to type one key at a time. 40 short lessons, starting with F and J on the home row and building up to sentences, numbers and symbols, and whole paragraphs, plus 1, 3 and 5-minute typing tests, with colors that show which finger to use. Finish a lesson and you get an egg to crack, with a new pet inside. Get 3 stars for a golden egg and a shiny pet. There are 41 pets to collect.
notes: Plain DOM game (no kit). Was Typing Pets (slug typing-pets until Nov 2026: the old addresses answer 301, server/renamed.js; the save key stays typing-pets-v1). 40 lessons in five units (home row, top row, bottom row, big letters and sentences, numbers and symbols), each adding keys to the ones before; every lesson is 3 lines of 34 characters made from the allowed keys (letter drills, then real words and sentences). The next key is lit on an on-screen US QWERTY keyboard colored by finger, with the finger named under the line; the keys can be tapped, so it also works on a tablet. A wrong key shakes the line and must be fixed before moving on; it counts once per letter. Stars by accuracy: 3 at 95% or better, 2 at 85%, else 1. Speed is words a minute (5 characters a word, capped at 200). Each finished lesson gives an egg to crack (tap it 4 times); a 3-star lesson gives a golden egg and a shiny pet. 41 pets, all full-body animals: Google's Noto Emoji pictures (Apache 2.0; the animated loops CC BY 4.0, credited in the collection), vendored as pinned scripts in public/vendor/data/typing-zoo-art/<version>/ (tools/typing-zoo-art/build.py; the frame loads no picture from another host), the emoji until they load. New pets go at the end of PETS; fox, panda, koala, lion, frog, unicorn, hamster and bear became giraffe, elephant, kangaroo, leopard, lizard, pony, chipmunk and hippo (an old save's pet is read as the new one). Once all are found, eggs make pets shiny. The chosen pet ('Walk with me' in the collection, save.out) or the latest hatched walks on its own lane under the top bar, never over the line, the keyboard or a button: left and right only with a little hop, toward the pointer (or the last tap), wandering when left alone, settling at the end of the line and bouncing on a finished line while the player types; still with reduced motion; 'Walking pet: off' in the collection (save.walkOff). Lessons unlock in order. Timed tests (1, 3 and 5 minutes, chapter t1/t3/t5) open after Lesson 12 and keep each length's best run and the last 20 runs. 'Practice my tricky keys' (chapter=tricky) drills the keys missed most. Saved in BRB.storage key 'typing-pets-v1': per lesson best stars, best speed, best accuracy, tries and the last result; the pets; hits and misses per key; total seconds typed. Teachers see this in the class progress page (server/services/typing.js reads the saves). BRB.params chapter=l01..l20 with lock=1 opens just that lesson (a class lesson step); a finished lesson submits the speed as the score with the accuracy and stars in the label, then BRB.gameOver. window.__brbTest: lesson, type, typeAll, crackAll, pets, lessons, save, walk.

es.title: Zoo del Teclado
es.description: Aprende a escribir con el teclado, tecla a tecla. 40 lecciones cortas, desde la F y la J hasta frases, con colores que muestran qué dedo usar. Al terminar cada lección rompes un huevo con una mascota nueva dentro. Hay 41 mascotas para coleccionar.

fr.title: Zoo du Clavier
fr.description: Apprends à taper au clavier, une touche à la fois. 40 petites leçons, de F et J jusqu’aux phrases, avec des couleurs qui montrent quel doigt utiliser. À la fin de chaque leçon, tu casses un œuf avec un nouvel animal dedans. 41 animaux à collectionner.

de.title: Tipp-Zoo
de.description: Lerne Tippen, eine Taste nach der anderen. 40 kurze Lektionen von F und J bis zu Sätzen, mit Farben, die zeigen, welcher Finger dran ist. Nach jeder Lektion knackst du ein Ei mit einem neuen Tier darin. 41 Tiere zum Sammeln.

it.title: Zoo della Tastiera
it.description: Impara a scrivere con la tastiera, un tasto alla volta. 40 brevi lezioni, dalla F e la J fino alle frasi, con i colori che mostrano quale dito usare. Alla fine di ogni lezione rompi un uovo con un nuovo cucciolo dentro. 41 cuccioli da collezionare.

pt.title: Zoo do Teclado
pt.description: Aprenda a digitar, uma tecla de cada vez. 40 lições curtas, do F e J até frases, com cores que mostram qual dedo usar. No fim de cada lição você quebra um ovo com um bichinho novo dentro. São 41 bichinhos para colecionar.

nl.title: Typdierentuin
nl.description: Leer typen, één toets tegelijk. 40 korte lessen, van F en J tot zinnen, met kleuren die laten zien welke vinger je gebruikt. Na elke les tik je een ei open met een nieuw dier erin. 41 dieren om te verzamelen.

ru.title: Клавиатурный зоопарк
ru.description: Учись печатать по одной клавише. 40 коротких уроков, от F и J до предложений, с цветами, которые показывают, каким пальцем нажимать. После каждого урока разбей яйцо, а внутри новый питомец. 41 питомец для коллекции.

ja.title: タイピングどうぶつえん
ja.description: キーをひとつずつおぼえてタイピングを学ぼう。FとJから文まで、40のみじかいレッスン。どのゆびを使うかは色でわかるよ。レッスンが終わるとたまごをわって、新しいペットが生まれます。ペットは41ひき。
ja.tags: タイピング,キーボード,ブラインドタッチ,ゆび,れんしゅう,ペット,小学生

zh-Hant.title: 打字動物園
zh-Hant.description: 一次學一個鍵，學會打字。從 F 和 J 到句子，共 40 個短課程，用顏色告訴你該用哪根手指。每完成一課就能敲開一顆蛋，裡面有新寵物。共有 41 隻寵物可以收集。
zh-Hant.tags: 打字,鍵盤,盲打,手指,練習,寵物,小學

ar.title: حديقة حيوانات الكتابة
ar.description: تعلّم الكتابة على لوحة المفاتيح مفتاحًا بعد مفتاح. 40 درسًا قصيرًا من F وJ حتى الجمل، مع ألوان تبيّن أي إصبع تستخدم. بعد كل درس تكسر بيضة فيها حيوان أليف جديد. هناك 41 حيوانًا لتجمعها.

he.title: גן החיות של המקלדת
he.description: לומדים להקליד, מקש אחרי מקש. 40 שיעורים קצרים, מ-F ו-J ועד משפטים, עם צבעים שמראים באיזו אצבע להשתמש. בסוף כל שיעור שוברים ביצה ובתוכה חיה חדשה. יש 41 חיות לאסוף.
